limitations: Runs on the owner's laptop over the internet, outside us-west-2. Every transfer time includes that path. Assumption A25.
In vsicurl mode, requests and bytes come from GDAL's debug log of requested ranges. Network counters are machine-wide and include other traffic.

One acquisition of one tile. Whole-tile reads only. No polygon, no extraction.
Digest equality between copies compares decoded integers. It says nothing about the offset state, scaling, or georeferencing.
